title: HybridQA: A Dataset of Multi-Hop Question Answering over Tabular and Textual Data

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing preliminary crowdsourced questions to identify annotator shortcuts and positional preferences, specifically 'Table Bias' (preferring the top of the table), 'Passage Bias' (preferring the first few sentences), and 'Question Bias' (creating fake multi-hop questions). These are evaluated and mitigated using UI highlighting, algorithmic span rejection, and human expert filtering.
